name: notify
description: A desktop notification when Claude Code needs you, or when a long turn finishes. One OSC write through the pty, so it works on a headless or remote host.

notify_osc.title: OSC sequence
notify_osc.description: Which notification escape sequence to write: 777 for VS Code, tmux, and urxvt; 9 for iTerm2; 99 for kitty, WezTerm, and Ghostty. A terminal that does not read the sequence drops it without an error.

notify_title.title: Banner title
notify_title.description: Title for both events. Leave it blank for "Claude Code" on Notification and "Claude Code: done" on Stop. A value here covers both events, so set the done title too if you want to tell them apart.

notify_title_done.title: Banner title for a finished turn
notify_title_done.description: Title for the Stop event only. It wins over the shared title, which is how you keep the needs-you and finished banners distinct.
